title: Service Line CalcVATAmountLines: count VAT Difference once and clear filters before OnAfterCalcVATAmountLines
summary: Service Line CalcVATAmountLines now counts VAT differences correctly and clears filters before firing the OnAfterCalcVATAmountLines event, matching the behavior of Sales and Purchase lines.
key_points: Fixed VAT difference being counted twice in the accumulation by removing redundant term
Added VATAmountLine.Reset() before OnAfterCalcVATAmountLines event to ensure unfiltered records
Aligns Service Line implementation with Sales Line and Purchase Line behavior
Applied fix to both W1 and NA table layers
Added two regression tests covering VAT difference counting and filter clearing scenarios
